description: Queue a windowed AI assessment that scores every file in the evidence item's frequency window as one portfolio (write — editor+ role, async). Returns 422 if tracking or frequency is missing.

assessment_source.description: Origin tag for the request (default on_demand)

evidence_id.description: Evidence ID (e.g., 'E-IAM-01'). Tracking row with a frequency must exist — set via scf_update_evidence first

name: scf_trigger_window_assessment
